probe: TI LP-XDS110ET (standalone XDS110 debug probe board, no onboard target)
note: Metadata only. The LP-XDS110ET has no target: P7 is a 10-pin ARM Cortex Debug connector, P10 a 20-pin LaunchPad connector, P9 selects the level-shifter voltage. Nothing was connected, so there is no DPIDR, AP, CPUID, memory or run-control evidence, and the all-zero JTAG scan and the SWD protocol error are the expected no-target behaviour.

usb.serial: sanitized (the real USB serial is not committed)

interfaces.role: vendor bulk, not the debug channel; candidate EnergyTrace channel (unverified)

xds110.frame: '*' + u16 LE length + command + arguments; reply = int32 LE status + data

clock.claim: accepted only; host-timed rates are below nominal because the burst includes USB overhead. No precision is claimed

no_target_behaviour.swd_attach: XDS110 command 0x0f: SWD protocol error (-615), reported explicitly, probe stays usable
no_target_behaviour.jtag_scan: 320 bits read all zeros, status stuck-low, no device

usb_behaviour.cdc_coexistence: interfaces 0,1,3,4 stayed cdc_acm, ttyACM1 and ttyACM2 stayed present and were opened while hwlab held interface 2; interface 5 stayed usbhid
usb_behaviour.cmsisdap_face_coexistence: the cmsisdap plugin opened the HID face at the same time and answered DAP_Info (CMSIS-DAP 1.2.0)

energytrace: NOT_IMPLEMENTED: the protocol is not public and no oracle was available; interface 6 was probed only with one DAP_Info-shaped write (reply 01 00) and no further fuzzing
